target: the token estimate is the same number under any locale — a threshold decision must not depend on the machine it runs on
cmd: cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-large.json" | LC_ALL=C MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary 2>ec >/dev/null; cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-large.json" | LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary 2>eu >/dev/null; grep -qi estimate ec && cmp -s ec eu && echo LOCALE_INDEPENDENT
